title: On Moving the whole stack before noon
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：move　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 move 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 the tailor ① moved the whole stack before noon in public, and every customer in the shop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the tailor ② moves the whole stack before noon in silence without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ move the whole stack before noon at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ moved the whole stack before noon before — a line in the order for November 1959 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Moving the whole stack before noon in public, the tailor said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the needle at the far mirror, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ move everybody in the crowded hall in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Move everybody in the crowded hall at once and never mention it again.

By 1972 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the order, and a new customer from the next shop ⑧ moves everybody in the crowded hall in public every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the mirror, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ moved the whole stack before noon again when nobody else would.

⑩ To move the whole stack before noon, my mother said in 1977, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the shop remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the shop forgets, somebody moves the whole stack before noon in silence again and somebody must move the whole stack before noon in public all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 移动（一般过去式 moved the whole stack before noon：1965 年裁缝头一回这样做，当着众人面）
B. v. 移动（一般现在 moves the whole stack before noon：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 移动（不定式 to move the whole stack before noon：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 移动（过去完成时 had moved the whole stack before noon：1959 年十一月的订单簿上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 移动（动名词 moving the whole stack before noon 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 使感动（move everybody in the crowded hall：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去使感动让大厅里人人动容）
G. v. 使感动（move everybody in the crowded hall：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 移动（后段两处：新来的顾客照例 moves everybody in the crowded hall，而母亲又一次 moved the whole stack before noon）

answers.why: move 意为“移动”，1965 年裁缝当着众人面移动午前把整个垛搬完，那是裁缝铺里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 moved。
move 意为“移动”，自那以后裁缝一言不发地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 moves。
move 意为“移动”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯移动午前把整个垛搬完”，此处为不定式 to move the whole stack before noon。
move 意为“移动”，订单簿里 十一月 那行字说明早在 1972 年之前就有人移动过，故用过去完成时 had moved。
move 意为“移动”，裁缝说“移动午前把整个垛搬完这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 moving the whole stack before noon 作主语。
move 意为“使感动”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去使感动让大厅里人人动容”，should ever 之后用原形 move everybody in the crowded hall。
move 意为“使感动”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻使感动让大厅里人人动容（move everybody in the crowded hall at once），以后再也不要提起。
move 意为“移动”，新来的顾客每个星期都照例使感动让大厅里人人动容，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 moves。
move 意为“移动”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当着众人面移动午前把整个垛搬完，用一般过去式 moved 叙述。
move 意为“移动”，结尾那句是母亲 1977 年的话：要移动午前把整个垛搬完，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和裁缝铺记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 move 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1965 the tailor moved the whole stack before noon in public, and nobody in the shop forgot it.
Even now the tailor moves the whole stack before noon in silence whenever the shop asks.
Moving the whole stack before noon in public, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever move everybody in the crowded hall in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new customer from the next shop moves everybody in the crowded hall in public every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother moved the whole stack before noon again, and the shop remembered that half.
